query_analysis.original_query: Design a comprehensive monitoring strategy for detecting early signs of column internals degradation in our atmospheric distillation unit.
query_analysis.expanded_query: Develop a detailed and comprehensive monitoring strategy to detect early signs of degradation in the column internals of our atmospheric distillation unit, including identifying key parameters to monitor, selecting appropriate sensing and inspection technologies, and establishing effective data analysis and maintenance protocols to ensure proactive maintenance and prevent operational disruptions.

selected_agents.role: Designing the monitoring strategy and selecting appropriate technologies and instrumentation
Identifying potential degradation mechanisms and determining key parameters to monitor
Integrating safety considerations and ensuring compliance with safety regulations

communication_strategy.information_flow: Collaborative development of monitoring approaches with input on degradation mechanisms and safety considerations
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Iterative strategy refinement and cross-disciplinary integration

clarification_questions: What specific degradation mechanisms are of concern in your atmospheric distillation unit?
Do you have any existing monitoring systems or historical data on the condition of the column internals?
Are there any constraints regarding sensor installation, budget, or maintenance schedules?
